evidence_tier_definition.label: Tier 2c — Nearest-neighbor
evidence_tier_definition.definition: No direct test exists for this exact drug x modifier x cell-line combination, but the same drug x modifier pair was tested directly in a molecularly similar cell line (matched on shared mutations and tissue/lineage). Extrapolated from that real result, weighted by similarity -- the borrowed source interaction(s) are always named and cited, never a hidden score. Weaker than a direct test in this exact line; stronger than a pure mechanism-overlap guess since it rests on a real measured combination, just in a different (similar) cell line.
